observations: Existing ServicesAPI.REASONER.VALIDATE_DOCUMENT and authenticated ReasonerController map POST /api/v1/validate/document; not a proposed experimental route.
SemanticValidationRequest carries one parsed namespace or ontology, documentVersion and optional expected knowledgeRevision; sourceHash hashes exact UTF-8 source including whitespace.
Response.matches pins document URN/version/source hash, knowledge revision and executable/classifier/context options. COMPLETE is not necessarily valid: native valid() also checks Error diagnostics.

Response semanticSessionId and semanticContentFingerprint, together with Reasoner capability worldview/service/revision, distinguish source diagnostics across knowledge snapshots; no executable completeness is inferred from sourceSemanticsComplete.

ReasonerService ontology paths can synchronize saved source and loadKnowledge/repair candidate worldview. Python facade therefore refuses ontology validation before network and never sends executableModel, executionContext or pending-classifier proof claims.
Namespace source diagnostics remain server-reported. Finite simulator admits exactly two namespace literals and a declared error, not a parser/compiler/ontology implementation.
authorization_boundary: No live native validation or worldview/IDE repair authorized or performed; future native test must be approved namespace-only source diagnostics on prepared services
